text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I would like your help in making 
chocolates to offer to Vodka-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was right at the start of February when 
she came to me with that request.
choice_data_list: Oh, could this be for Valentine's?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Because you have helped me so, so 
very much.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"However, in striving for perfection, I 
face many dilemmas... I would be truly 
grateful for your assistance, my dear 
friend."
choice_data_list:
If I'm good enough for you, then of 
course!
If you're okay with me, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I personally owe Vodka a tremendous debt 
of gratitude. Without hesitation, I nodded 
and promised my cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. In order to quickly settle 
on a recipe, we all headed to the kitchen 
together.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, the theme is "super 
cool" chocolates worthy of Vodka-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"A 'cool' chocolate... but, I can't decide 
on the crucial shape."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Simply incorporating motifs that Vodka 
likes into chocolate and gifting it to her 
should do nicely as well.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Still, as for me... I would like to give 
something with a little more thought put 
into it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The crown jewel of chocolate cakes, the 
Opéra; macarons, which convey strong 
feelings through the sheer effort they 
require... ...Ah, bonbons de chocolat are 
hard to pass up as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It seems that caring too much 
for the other has bred hesitation.
choice_data_list:
Shouldn't you match the chocolate to the 
recipient's tastes?

Shouldn't you match the chocolate to their 
tastes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that putting in time and effort 
without considering the other person just 
turns it into self-satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. You are entirely correct.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... In that case, I'll save whatever 
feelings overflow for another time...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
! No, wait! Why wait for another 
time—couldn't we just get fancy with the 
wrapping, or include another gift with 
it!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, we can pour all our 
feelings into it...! ...Let's go with 
this, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My! How utterly gorgeous this gift box 
is...!
choice_data_list: Sounds good. I think I might like it too.
Sounds good! I think I might like it too.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...However, this one looks cooler and 
seems more like Vodka... Hmmm."
choice_data_list: That might be true.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
! I knew it, that makes sense! ...I'll 
save the red one for another time♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A message card... Which would be better: 
this Vodka-colored one, or the gold and 
black one?
choice_data_list:
If you want a more mature vibe, maybe the 
gold and black one.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A mature vibe... Then let us make this our 
top choice!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"By the way... Which one does Trainer 
prefer?"
choice_data_list: Me? Let's see... maybe this one?
Me? Let's see... maybe this one?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My! That one is quite lovely as well... 
Thank you, that was very helpful.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-mm♪ Hum-de-dum♪ ...My, what a lovely 
silver pen this is.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if there's anything good in 
black. Or maybe something that would go 
well with Vodka's sukajan...
choice_data_list: (Her quirks really stand out, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her heart flutter as she thinks of 
the one she admires makes her look just 
like any ordinary student. Watching such a 
heartwarming sight naturally brought a 
smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Then there's something related to 
motorcycles...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ! This... This is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Valentine's Day arrived. I quietly 
watch over the situation from the corner 
of the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san, here. Um... it's a small 
gesture, but please accept this 
celebratory chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, for me!? Seriously!? Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOOO!? What is with this 
chocolate?! So awesome! So cool!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is my racewear! And this one 
looks like Gim-senpai's! So cool, so cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh? There's a cool silver keychain in 
here too!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That's a Guardian Bell. It's an amulet to 
ward off evil for motorcycle riders.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I offered prayers for three days and three 
nights so that Vodka-san's journey would 
be safe. ...I would be glad if you 
accepted it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Desire... thank you so much, seriously! 
I'm so, so stoked! I'll definitely put it 
on once I start riding a bike!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Hey! Can I eat the chocolate now too? It 
looks so good, I can't hold back anymore!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Of course...♪
choice_data_list:
(Thank goodness, it looks like it went 
well.)
(Thank goodness, looks like it went well)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much, Trainer. Vodka was 
very pleased with it.
choice_data_list:
I was watching. It was a huge success, 
huh!

I was watching. It was a huge success, 
wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It is all thanks to your devoted 
support.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And so—this is my way of showing my 
gratitude. Happy Valentine's Day, 
Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: ...Wait, no way! For me?!
...Wait, no way! For me?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Whatever is there to be surprised about?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"As a devotee of the Saint, you have 
fulfilled your duty splendidly."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Your faith elevated my standing as a 
saintess... and thus, I was able to 
fulfill my sacred duty."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Please, be proud.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When on earth did she prepare this? I was 
so astonished that my jaw dropped.
choice_data_list: Mind if I try opening it?
Can I try opening it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the nod, a hand gently reaches for 
the box. And once again, her mouth falls 
wide open in surprise.
choice_data_list: Wait, it's different from Vodka's!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course. For you, there is a 
specific form of blessing that ought to be 
bestowed upon you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If the taste isn't to your liking, the 
feelings poured into it will fade away 
too. ...Those were the words you dedicated 
to me, weren't they?
choice_data_list: Desire...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart filled with deep emotion, I 
popped a piece of chocolate into my mouth.
choice_data_list: Delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The flavor hit the bullseye of my taste. 
Looking closely, even the box and the 
message card were things I had once 
mentioned liking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A single bite confirmed it. This was, 
without a doubt —chocolate made with me in 
mind."
choice_data_list: I am truly... beyond honored, Holy Maiden.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, think nothing of it. ...The 
happiness of my worshippers is proof of a 
saint's power.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And... that smile is precisely what 
fulfills a saint's soul.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even right now, you see... Your smile 
fills my soul with such profound joy.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I am so very happy.
